changes: Added evidence-quality scoring, reviewer quorum diagnostics, structured attestation checks, actor trust checks, external fact provenance checks, and refresh metadata preservation across the Koala CLI verification pipeline.
usage: Use normal Koala checklist evidence commands and koala validate; strict workflow profiles now surface weak evidence, unsafe reviewer identity, weak attestation, actor trust, and fact provenance diagnostics in verification coverage.
expectedOutcome: A story cannot pass strict evidence gates with shallow natural-language claims, weak commands, self-verification, stale CI/human claims, revoked actors, or unsupported external facts.
actualTranscript: build and all smoke tests passed; koala validate returned pass with project tests passed and verification intent coverage 20/20 covered, 0 required missing; reviewers concept, quality, test-coverage, and docs passed with no findings.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for the implemented gate behavior; docs reviewer noted non-blocking truth-source doc expansion remains advisory.
limitations: Live validation evaluates actorTrust/factProvenance when metadata is present; stricter default requirements such as mandatory actor metadata or primary source can be future policy work.
pitfalls: One quality reviewer stalled and was restarted with a narrower prompt; refresh_stale initially would have dropped new structured metadata, so CHK-005 added a preservation test and fix.
